description: This file contains React components for displaying a list of posts, including individual post cards, with styling and links.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the structure of a post object, including id, slug, title, excerpt, tags, status, and updatedAt.

methods.name: PostCard
methods.description: React component that renders an individual post as a card, displaying title, excerpt, tags, and update date with styling.

methods.name: PostList
methods.description: React component that renders a list of Post objects as a grid of PostCards, or a message if no posts are present.
